mapper.select:
SELECT R.schedule_DATE, /*排产日期*/ null CD15_BATCH_NO, MAX(R.CX_BATCH_NO) CX_BATCH_NO, /*成型批次号*/ CI.ARTICLE_CROWN_SPEC BIG_ROLL_CODE, /*钢带规格*/ NVL(ROUND(SUM((nvl(R.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY, 0) + nvl(R.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0) + nvl(R.CLASS3_PLAN_QTY, 0)) * nvl(CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER, 0) * (NVL(CI.BELT_CRAFT1, 0) + NVL(CI.BELT_CRAFT2, 0)) / #{breadth} / 1000 / 1000), 6), 0) CLASS1_PLAN, /*大卷计划量，换算成米*/ NVL(ROUND(SUM((nvl(R.CLASS4_PLAN_QTY, 0) + nvl(R.CLASS5_PLAN_QTY, 0)) * nvl(CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER, 0) * (NVL(CI.BELT_CRAFT1, 0) + NVL(CI.BELT_CRAFT2, 0)) / #{breadth} / 1000 / 1000), 6), 0) CLASS2_PLAN /*大卷计划量*/ FROM T_CX_schedule_RESULT R LEFT JOIN T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI ON R.EMBRYO_CODE = CI.EMBRYO_CODE AND R.BOM_DATA_VERSION = CI.EMBRYO_VERSION WHERE R.schedule_DATE = #{scheduleDate} AND R.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND CI.DEL_FLAG = '0'
/* 仅对投产阶段的规格排产 */ AND CI.PRODUCTION_STAGE = '0'
GROUP BY R.SCHEDULE_DATE, CI.ARTICLE_CROWN_SPEC
HAVING SUM((NVL(R.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY, 0) + NVL(R.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0) + NVL(R.CLASS3_PLAN_QTY, 0) + NVL(R.CLASS4_PLAN_QTY, 0) + NVL(R.CLASS5_PLAN_QTY, 0)) * CI.FIT_DRUM_PERIMETER * (NVL(CI.BELT_CRAFT1, 0) + NVL(CI.BELT_CRAFT2, 0))) != 0
select param_code, param_value from T_GDYY_PARAMS where DEL_FLAG = '0'
SELECT MAX(BATCH_NO) BATCH_NO FROM T_GDYY_AUTO_SCHEDULE_RECORD WHERE schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into T_GDYY_AUTO_SCHEDULE_RECORD (ID, CX_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, STATUS, SCHEDULE_DATE, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, DEL_FLAG) values (SEQ_AUTO_SCHEDULE_RECORD.Nextval, #{cxBatchNo}, #{batchNo}, #{status}, #{scheduleDate}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{delFlag})

INSERT INTO T_GDYY_SCHEDULE_RESULT_LOG (ID, SCHEDULE_DATE, CD15_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, BIG_ROLL_CODE, DAY_USED, STOCK_QTY, CLASS1_PLAN, CLASS1_PLAN_NO_STOCK, CLASS1_FINISH, CLASS1_REMARK, CLASS2_PLAN, CLASS2_PLAN_NO_STOCK, CLASS2_FINISH, CLASS2_REMARK, CLASS3_PLAN, CLASS3_FINISH, CLASS3_REMARK, IS_RELEASE, PUBLISH_SUCCESS_COUNT, NEWEST_PUBLISH_TIME, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, data_source, CLOSE_OUT_SPEC_FLAG, CLASS1_PLAN_NUM, CLASS2_PLAN_NUM, CLASS3_PLAN_NUM) SELECT ID, SCHEDULE_DATE, CD15_BATCH_NO, BATCH_NO, ORDER_NO, BIG_ROLL_CODE, DAY_USED, STOCK_QTY, CLASS1_PLAN, CLASS1_PLAN_NO_STOCK, CLASS1_FINISH, CLASS1_REMARK, CLASS2_PLAN, CLASS2_PLAN_NO_STOCK, CLASS2_FINISH, CLASS2_REMARK, CLASS3_PLAN, CLASS3_FINISH, CLASS3_REMARK, IS_RELEASE, PUBLISH_SUCCESS_COUNT, NEWEST_PUBLISH_TIME, REMARK, DEL_FLAG, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, MARK_CLOSE_OUT_TIP, PRODUCTION_STATUS, data_source, CLOSE_OUT_SPEC_FLAG, CLASS1_PLAN_NUM, CLASS2_PLAN_NUM, CLASS3_PLAN_NUM FROM T_GDYY_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate}
